title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Member Appeal Reference: Out-of-Network Plans Paying Second
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — member appeals to an out-of-network plan that pays second.** A patient may appeal the denials of an out-of-network health plan that pays second for them. The company's rule for these member appeals fixes the amount in dispute recorded on the appeal.

## Lodging and authorization

Where the payer class requires the patient's authorization for an appeal, a member appeal is lodged by the patient's own signature on the member appeal request, which names the laboratory as the patient's authorized representative for that claim.

The second-plan member appeal's amount is not recorded until the claim held by the plan paying first for the same order carries a first-level appeal.

Put another way, the recording of the member appeal's amount waits on the state of the claim held by the plan paying first for that order: until that claim carries a first-level appeal, no amount is recorded on the member appeal.

## Capability

`sign_member_appeal_c7144598` lets the patient personally sign and lodge a member appeal with an out-of-network health plan that pays second for them, naming Halverson Clinical Laboratories as their authorized representative for the claim. One run records one member appeal filing, dated today, on the claim ledger of that coverage: the claim number, the order the claim bills, the denial line appealed, the appeal level and the amount in dispute. Nothing else on the coverage or the claim changes.

## Invocation

This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `sign_member_appeal_c7144598` for the patient and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it and signs. The values the patient enters are given to the patient by the representative.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage_id` | Reference number of the patient's coverage the member appeal is lodged with, as given by the representative | Id |
| `customer_id` | The patient's own customer reference number, as given by the representative | Id |
| `claim_number` | Laboratory claim number of the appealed claim, as given by the representative | 'C' followed by 10 digits |
| `order_id` | Reference number of the order the appealed claim bills, as given by the representative | Id |
| `source_claim_event_id` | Reference number of the denial line appealed, as given by the representative | Id |
| `appeal_level` | The appeal level lodged: `first_level` when no appeal has yet been lodged on this claim; `second_level` when the first-level appeal was decided and is being taken further; `third_level` when the second-level appeal was decided and is being taken to the final review | One of `first_level`, `second_level`, `third_level` |
| `amount_in_dispute` | Amount in dispute recorded on the member appeal, as told to the patient by the representative | USD with 2 decimal places, a positive number rounded half up to the cent |

## Return

A text receipt returned to the patient, carrying `claim_event_id` (reference number of the lodged member appeal), `event_type` with the value `coverage_appeal_filed`, `claim_number` and `appeal_level` (echoing the claim and level), `amount` (the amount in dispute recorded, USD with 2 decimal places) and `event_date` (today's date as YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying a `claim_event_id` means the member appeal was lodged.
